caseName: Puerto Rico Cement Corp. v. Royal Indemnity Co.
caseNameFull: Puerto Rico Cement Corp. v. Royal Indemnity Co.
attorneys: Mr. L. E. Dubon for petitioner., Mr. Roscoe Walsworth for respondent. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Shea, and Mr. Abraham, J. Harris filed a brief on behalf of the United States, as amicus curiae, in opposition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the First Circuit denied.
